translations.en: A sheet of paper was attached to the wall.
Its condition showed that it was old.
To help adventurers who come after me,
I record the features of this labyrinth here.
That was the only sentence written on it,
leaving a large expanse of blank space...
Large letters were written on the floor.
"To the east..."
The end of the message had been gouged away by a powerful spell.
A message was written in large letters on a sign.
"If you think it's dangerous, turn back!"
You kicked something!
The Healing Salve you had kicked rolled around your feet...
You obtained Healing Salve!
Your inventory is full!
Something lay on the floor...
You found a Magic Torch!
You obtained a Magic Torch!
Something was hidden in a recess in the wall.
You gently took it out.
It was Smelling Salts.
You obtained Smelling Salts!
Something suddenly darted past your feet.
It was hard to tell in the darkness,
but it seemed to be a small animal.
It disappeared somewhere with astonishing speed.
Looking down, you noticed a scrap of paper.
It read:
"I ate the bread and drank the milk I was supposed to buy.
There's nothing useful left in my bag."
"I was only supposed to tag along for a little while.
How did it come to this...?"
The scrap of paper bore feeble handwriting.
You noticed your footsteps sounded different and looked down.
You were stepping on a scrap of paper.
"We've been in this labyrinth longer than I expected.
I no longer even know
how much time has passed."
A scrap of paper lay on the floor.
You picked it up and read the words.
"I'm getting too tired even to open my mouth.
My companion still looks full of energy,
but I wonder."
A small scrap of paper lay beside the path...
"We've been wandering this labyrinth for a long time.
We've run out of bread to eat.
When I told my companion, the answer was..."
"If there's no bread, just eat cake."
You found a scrap of paper lying in the passage.
"I'm thirsty."
"I thought we'd be back aboveground in no time,
so the only drinking water we have
is in the little flask I had with me."
"And even that water is about to run..."
The rest was too faded to read.
Something was written in neat handwriting
on the door before you.
"Nobody's Here."
"I should have asked the party we met earlier
if they could at least spare
some drinking water."
"In a labyrinth like this, who knows if we'll meet anyone else...?"
The hurried-looking handwriting stood out.
It looked as though the words had been scrawled in anger.
"I'm hungry!"
A complicated pattern covered the floor.
It seemed to be a map of this labyrinth,
but it did not look particularly reliable...
A mysterious voice came from nowhere.
"Isn't it time you tried turning back?
Is there really any need to hurry...?"
A solemn voice reached your ears from nowhere.
"Know the limits of your abilities..."
When the voice faded,
silence settled over the surroundings.
Nearby, you found bleached human bones.
The skeleton still held its human shape perfectly.
You could speak to it,
but of course there would be no reply.
There was a battered door...
